messages:
Ilya - NovaChannel: Hey Redwood team — excited to start the co-sell pilot. Our checklist: EU data residency (eu-west-1), SSO via SAML, pricing for ~5k req/day, expected latency SLO <200ms p50, and a one-page runbook for our ops team. Can we target next Wed for kickoff?
Maya R: Welcome Ilya! We can do eu-west. Looping Samir (pricing), Jordan (infra), Priya (customer ops). Wed works — what time zone?
Ilya - NovaChannel: CET midday (around 2pm CET) would be ideal. Also cc'd their infra lead (they may pop in later).
Samir K: Quick back-of-envelope: 5k req/day -> ~150k/mo. With avg 100 tokens, estimated hosted cost ~$3k-$6k/month. Dedicated reserved option available for predictable latency and isolation. Will send pro-forma pricing and a 6-week pilot pro-rate option by EOD.
Jordan L: For SSO we can provide a test SP metadata and a temp tenant. Two infra choices: hosted multi-tenant or dedicated POC on a small GPU pool. Dedicated gives stronger latency guarantees and private network. Example curl to smoke test once tenant is up:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer TEMP_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"test prompt"}' \
  https://api.eu-west-1.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Priya S: I'll draft the one-page runbook template: auth, smoke tests, rollback steps, contacts. Also suggest a 30-min enablement for NovaChannel engineers after tenant is provisioned.
Ilya - NovaChannel: Awesome. A couple of enterprise blockers to flag: (1) need SOC2 report to be able to present to procurement, (2) legal wants clarification on data sub-processing, (3) they want a 7-day log retention window for the pilot.
sec-bot: Security questionnaire created: https://redwood.ai/sec-queue/NOVACH-2026-04 assigned to Priya S. Deadline: 2026-04-02.
Priya S: Noted — I'll pull SOC2 + subprocessing language from our legal pack. For log retention, SRE can set retention to 7 days for the pilot. Looping ops-bot for retention config.
ops-bot: SRE ticket created: SRE-3412. Temporary log retention settable to 7 days for tenant. Contact: jordan.l@redwood.ai.
Jordan L: I'll provision eu-west tenant and a temp API key today. If NovaChannel wants the dedicated POC, need confirmation on isolation and commit window.
Ilya - NovaChannel: For the first week we'll use hosted tenant; if latency ok, may switch to dedicated. Also: can you include a canary/rollout plan for model fallback if the primary model degrades? Procurement asked about graceful degradation.
Maya R: Yes — we have automatic fallback policies that route to a cheaper lower-capacity variant if latency spikes or errors exceed thresholds. We'll include that in the runbook.
Samir K: Pricing note: dedicated option increases base cost but lowers per-token. I'll include the fallback cost impact and a sample SLA credit table for p50/p95 targets.
Priya S: Proposed actions: 1) Jordan -> temp tenant + API key + SAML SP metadata by EOD. 2) Priya -> runbook + enablement invite. 3) Samir -> pricing email with pro-rate 6-week option. 4) Ilya -> share SSO IdP metadata and procurement contact.
Ilya - NovaChannel: Doing that now — sending IdP metadata and procurement email. Also FYI, NovaChannel will not share user PII for the pilot.
Jordan L: Tenant created: https://dash.redwood.ai/tenants/novach-poc (temp creds posted to shared vault). SAML SP metadata attached in the runbook.
Maya R: Scheduling kickoff 2pm CET Wed. Invite sent to attendees. Priya — please include a short agenda: intro, provisioning walkthrough, enablement, Q&A.
Priya S: Invite accepted. I'll upload the runbook draft to the partnership folder and attach links to SOC2 and subprocessing docs.
sec-bot: SOC2 artifact link added by Priya S: https://redwood.ai/compliance/soc2/latest (internal only).
Samir K: Pricing email sent to Ilya with hosted and dedicated lines plus 6-week pro-rate. Will follow up on contract questions.
Ilya - NovaChannel: Received pricing, thanks. Quick Q on burst capacity — if we need short bursts over baseline, what's the delta?
Samir K: Burst = additional hourly capacity billed at premium. I'll add an example: 2x baseline for up to 48 hours with a 25% surcharge.
Maya R: Great progress. If any enterprise blockers remain after kickoff, flag here and we'll escalate to solutions engineering. :thumbsup:
Ilya - NovaChannel: Thanks team — see you Wed.
Jordan L: Closing loop: runbook link https://redwood.ai/partnerships/novach/poc-runbook (permissions: novach@novachannel.com + redwood). Temp API key rotated after initial tests.
Priya S: After kickoff we'll capture any follow-up enablement items and convert runbook to a polished customer-facing doc.
sec-bot: Security questionnaire status: In progress. Reminder set for 2026-04-01.
Samir K: I'll check back after the kickoff to finalize commercial terms.
Ilya - NovaChannel: Appreciate it. Quick thumbs-up from NovaChannel infra lead in thread: "looks good, will test SAML later today." :white_check_mark:
